page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 5 Gbps. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high memory-to-CPU ratio, the instance provides a memory-optimized resource profile. This density makes it suitable for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints relative to compute power, such as in-memory databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive enterprise applications, while avoiding the cost overhead of higher-tier compute-heavy or GPU-accelerated hardware.
